subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers — the agent answers with live widgets, not prose

question: Should Living Answers be accepted as bundled dashboard behavior, moved first to a ClawHub skill/convention, or folded into the broader modular dashboard tracker until the substrate lands?
rationale: The request mixes an agent-facing convention, persistent widget schema, store cleanup behavior, and Control UI affordances; automation can verify it is not on main, but cannot choose the product boundary or security/storage exceptions for a new dashboard surface.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
options.body: Keep this issue open and let the linked dashboard PR or a narrower replacement implement it after substrate, proof, storage, and security concerns are resolved.

options.title: Move Convention To ClawHub First
options.body: Treat the prompt-layer Living Answers convention as a ClawHub skill or bundle first, and defer bundled schema/UI changes until usage proves the need.

options.title: Fold Into Tracker
options.body: Move the unique TTL, pin, and Answers-tab details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and use that tracker as the sole remaining dashboard roadmap item.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and let the linked dashboard PR or a narrower replacement implement it after substrate, proof, storage, and security concerns are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Control UI plugin-tab seam introduced in the Logbook work and the repository's plugin/core boundary direction.
